2607.00918.title: From Personas to Plot: Character-Grounded Multi-Agent Story Generation for Long-Form Narratives
2607.00918.paper_summary: Although large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive creative fiction generation, they struggle to maintain narrative consistency and coherent plot lines in long-form stories. In this work, we introduce a unified framework for long-form narrative generation and verification. MAGNET, a multi-agent goal-driven narrative engine for storytelling, generates stories with persona-grounded character agents that propose actions based on a shared world state and evolving story goals, while ATLAS is a graph-based pipeline that compares scene-level world representations across a generated story to detect hallucinations. By evaluating MAGNET using an LLM editor, pairwise rubric scoring, and ATLAS, we show that our framework produces coherent narratives compared to single-model prompting and IBSEN. At 100 pages, MAGNET reduced annotations and hallucinations by 41 and 50%, respectively, compared to the single model baseline and by 34 and 45%, respectively, compared to IBSEN, with pairwise rubric evaluation showing similar results. These results suggest that long-form narratives can emerge from explicit world-state tracking and goal-driven multi-agent generation, providing a foundation for controllable and structurally coherent long-form narrative generation.
2607.00918.paper_summary_zh: 儘管大型語言模型 (LLMs) 在創造性小說生成方面表現出色，但在長篇故事中，它們仍然難以維持敘事一致性和連貫的情節線。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們介紹了一個統一的長篇敘事生成和驗證框架。<lb/>MAGNET 是一個以多代理為驅動的敘事引擎，專注於講故事，生成具有基於角色的角色代理的故事，這些角色根據共享的世界狀態和不斷演變的故事目標提出行動，而 ATLAS 則是一個基於圖的管道，通過比較生成故事中的場景級世界表徵來檢測幻覺。<lb/>通過使用 LLM 編輯器、成對評分標準和 ATLAS 評估 MAGNET，我們顯示出我們的框架相比於單一模型提示和 IBSEN 生成了連貫的敘事。<lb/>在 100 頁的情況下，MAGNET 分別減少了 41% 和 50% 的註釋和幻覺，相比於單一模型基準，並且分別減少了 34% 和 45% 的註釋和幻覺，相比於 IBSEN，成對評分評估顯示出類似的結果。<lb/>這些結果表明，長篇敘事可以通過明確的世界狀態跟踪和以目標為驅動的多代理生成而產生，為可控且結構上連貫的長篇敘事生成提供了基礎。
